content.name: [VAS] Enhanced Patrol AI - Test Harness
content.description: Technical test harness for Enhanced Patrol AI. Custom gamestart 'EPAI Test Harness' loads an empty purpose-built universe (no vanilla ships/jobs/stations/economy), spawns deterministic opposing task forces, sets faction relations (war/friendly), creates operational stations, and places private long-range test satellites for shared vision.
